document.title: Schneider Electric product data sheet — Characteristics GV2P16 (Motor circuit breaker, TeSys Deca/GV2, 3P, 9-14 A, thermal-magnetic, screw clamp terminals, rotary handle); RS Components mirror

modelingNotes: Manufacturer catalog spelling is GV2P16 (no separator); the job expectedOrderNumber GV2-P16 differs only by a presentation hyphen and denotes the same device, not a successor.

Terminal markings verified visually from the Schneider TeSys GV Catalogue 2017 (ref. LVCATESGV_EN, 06-2017) page 9 schematic DF510744: line 1/L1, 3/L2, 5/L3; load 2/T1, 4/T2, 6/T3; three poles, each thermal + magnetic (I>) element, mechanically linked by the common operating mechanism. https://www.electrocentr.com.ua/files/documentation/SE/motor-control/cb/TeSys_GV_cat_2017_en.pdf

Ratings (datasheet): In/Ith 14 A; thermal overload adjustable 9…14 A; magnetic trip fixed 170 A ±20 % (non-adjustable); Ue 690 V AC 50/60 Hz, Ui 690 V, Uimp 6 kV; AC-3 / Category A; Icu 100 kA at 400/415 V. These are capabilities/adjustment bounds, not a circuit voltage or installed trip setting.

Screw-clamp terminals, tightening torque 1.7 N·m; W45×H89×D97 mm; IP20; phase-failure sensitive; suitable for isolation (IEC 60947-1 §7-1-6). Conductor size, trip curves and short-circuit coordination are documentation, not automated conductor sizing.

Base GV2P16 carries only the 6 main power terminals: no protective-earth terminal (plastic-housed DIN-rail/panel device) and no integral auxiliary contact. Auxiliary/signaling blocks (GVAE, GVAD, GVAN), undervoltage/shunt releases and the GV2AK00 visible-isolation block are separately ordered add-ons with their own terminals and are not part of this order.
Three poles are mechanically ganged (common trip/handle), modeled as internal_relations ganged_with. Poles are switching contacts, not permanent net joins: no fixed links are declared.

The coordinator visually re-read2017 Section18 Table18.123: GV2P is in the rotary-handle column and GV2ME in the push-button column. The original worker reversed the column alignment; there is no North-American naming inversion in this table.

connectionCoverage.notes: The bare GV2P16 device's physical connection set is exactly the six main power terminals (line 1/L1, 3/L2, 5/L3; load 2/T1, 4/T2, 6/T3). No protective-earth terminal and no integral auxiliary contact exist on the device; separately-ordered accessory blocks are out of scope.
